description: Incidents, filtered. `state`: firing (default: every live incident, parked ones left out), unattended (firing, nobody has it, never a parked one), acknowledged, silenced, parked (a fix or a verdict that is not due yet: `parkedState`, `parkedUntil`, `parkedBy`, `parkedRef`, `parkedNote` say why, by whom and until when), resolved (episodes that ended in the last `hours`), or all (every incident, parked included). Filter by `severity`, `service` (substring) and `source` (the system that raised it: grafana, prod, sweep, netdata-cloud, ...). Resolved rows say whether a source resolved the incident or someone marked it resolved by hand, and who.

hours.description: How far back resolved incidents reach (default 24, most 720: Watch keeps 30 days).

limit.description: How many rows at most (default 50, most 200).

service.description: Only services whose name contains this, any case.

source.description: Only incidents raised by this source or system, exact name, any case.

state.description: Which incidents. Default firing (live ones, parked left out).

name: list_incidents
title: List incidents
